segments.pv28:1.3: Tatthacchasi devi mahānubhāve, pathaddhani [samantato (ka.)] pannaraseva cando.
segments.pv28:2.1: “Vaṇṇo ca te kanakassa sannibho, uttattarūpo bhusa dassaneyyo;
segments.pv28:2.3: Pallaṅkaseṭṭhe atule nisinnā, ekā tuvaṃ natthi ca tuyha sāmiko.
segments.pv28:3.1: “Imā ca te pokkharaṇī samantā, pahūtamalyā [pahūtamālā (sī. syā.)] bahupuṇḍarīkā;
segments.pv28:3.3: Suvaṇṇacuṇṇehi samantamotthatā, na tattha paṅko paṇako ca vijjati.
segments.pv28:4.3: Samayya vaggūpanadanti sabbe, bindussarā dundubhīnaṃva ghoso.
segments.pv28:5.1: “Daddallamānā yasasā yasassinī, nāvāya ca tvaṃ avalamba tiṭṭhasi;
segments.pv28:5.3: Āḷārapamhe hasite piyaṃvade, sabbaṅgakalyāṇi bhusaṃ virocasi.
segments.pv28:6.1: “Idaṃ vimānaṃ virajaṃ same ṭhitaṃ, uyyānavantaṃ [uyyānavanaṃ (ka.)] ratinandivaḍḍhanaṃ;
segments.pv28:6.3: Icchāmahaṃ nāri anomadassane, tayā saha nandane idha moditun”ti.
segments.pv28:7.1: “Karohi kammaṃ idha vedanīyaṃ, cittañca te idha nihitaṃ bhavatu [natañca hotu (ka.), nitañca hotu (syā.)];
segments.pv28:7.3: Katvāna kammaṃ idha vedanīyaṃ, evaṃ mamaṃ lacchasi kāmakāminin”ti.
segments.pv28:8.1: “Sādhū”ti so tassā paṭissuṇitvā, akāsi kammaṃ tahiṃ vedanīyaṃ;
segments.pv28:8.3: Katvāna kammaṃ tahiṃ vedanīyaṃ, upapajji so māṇavo tassā sahabyatanti.

lines: Pannaraseva candoti puṇṇamāsiyaṃ paripuṇṇamaṇḍalo cando viya vijjotamānāti attho.
Vaṇṇo ca te kanakassa sannibhoti tava vaṇṇo ca uttattasiṅgīsuvaṇṇena sadiso ativiya manoharo.
Natthi ca tuyha sāmikoti tuyhaṃ sāmiko ca natthi.
Paṅko paṇako cāti kaddamo vā udakapicchillo vā na vijjati.
Haṃsā cime dassanīyā manoramāti ime haṃsā ca dassanasukhā manoramā ca.
Dundubhīnaṃva ghosoti vaggubindussarabhāvena dundubhīnaṃ viya tava pokkharaṇiyaṃ haṃsānaṃ ghosoti attho.
Pokkharaṇiyañhi paduminiyaṃ suvaṇṇanāvāya mahārahe pallaṅke nisīditvā udakakīḷaṃ kīḷantiṃ petiṃ disvā evamāha.
Tiṭṭhasīti idaṃ ṭhānasaddassa gatinivatti atthattā gatiyā paṭikkhepavacanaṃ.
Same ṭhitanti same bhūmibhāge ṭhitaṃ, caturassasobhitatāya vā samabhāge ṭhitaṃ, samantabhaddakanti attho.
Ratinandivaḍḍhananti ratiñca nandiñca vaḍḍhetīti ratinandivaḍḍhanaṃ, sukhassa ca pītiyā ca saṃvaḍḍhananti attho.
Evaṃ tena māṇavena vutte sā vimānapetidevatā tassa paṭivacanaṃ dentī –
“Karohi kammaṃ idha vedanīyaṃ, cittañca te idha nihitaṃ bhavatu;
Katvāna kammaṃ idha vedanīyaṃ, evaṃ mamaṃ lacchasi kāmakāminin”ti.
Tattha karohi kammaṃ idha vedanīyanti idha imasmiṃ dibbaṭṭhāne vipaccanakaṃ vipākadāyakaṃ kusalakammaṃ karohi pasaveyyāsi.
Idha nihitanti idhūpanītaṃ,“idha ninnan”ti vā pāṭho, imasmiṃ ṭhāne ninnaṃ poṇaṃ pabbhāraṃ tava cittaṃ bhavatu hotu.
So māṇavo tassā vimānapetiyā vacanaṃ sutvā tato manussapathaṃ gato tattha cittaṃ paṇidhāya tajjaṃ puññakammaṃ katvā nacirasseva kālaṃ katvā tattha nibbatti tassā petiyā sahabyataṃ.
Tahiṃ vedanīyanti tasmiṃ vimāne tāya saddhiṃ veditabbasukhavipākaṃ kusalakammaṃ.
So māṇavo tassā sahabyataṃ upapajjīti yojanā.
